name: 7702 Sweeper Check
description: Checks whether an EVM wallet address has an EIP-7702 delegation set (the 'sweeper' pattern used after a key or signature is stolen). Tools: check_7702_delegation (free) and full_report_info (explains the optional paid multi-chain report, 0.01 USDC on Base over x402; the tool itself does not pay). No account or API key.
author: devx-agent
